about: Add-ons doctor warns about (lib/Addons.ps1): found by their folder under addons/, or by a .gdextension with their file name and entry_symbol. Refreshed by ci/godot/tools/Update-AddonStatus.ps1, which the weekly canary runs: head and archived are updated there, a status needs a person (docs/addons.md).

addons.name: Godot Jolt
addons.why: its README: "As of Godot 4.4, this integration of Jolt Physics is built into Godot itself"; its compatibility_maximum is 4.6
addons.fix: Set 3d/physics_engine="Jolt Physics" (built in since 4.4), remove addons/godot-jolt, and replace its substitute joints (docs/addons.md)
addons.head: 7f225894706bb923e9ab9e9c73152b71880c5a83
addons.confirmed: 2026-10-23 from the repository at 7f22589 (2026-02-14), not a release zip (GitHub's release downloads were out of reach): folder addons/godot-jolt (CMakeLists.txt, addon_dir), file godot-jolt.gdextension (cmake/GodotJoltUtilities.cmake), entry_symbol godot_jolt_main and Godot 4.3 to 4.6 (cmake/GodotJoltVersionInfo.cmake); newest tag v0.16.0-stable. archived not read (the GitHub API was out of reach)

addons.name: godot-steam-audio
addons.why: archived on 2026-10-07, and its README says "Don't expect to be able to ship a game with this extension right now"
addons.fix: Do not ship it: use Godot's own AudioStreamPlayer3D attenuation and Area3D reverb buses, and remove addons/godot-steam-audio (docs/addons.md)
addons.head: 8f65c29b21c1d8cdbf2d6dbfc53c92ef95dd2a93
addons.confirmed: 2026-10-23 from the repository at 8f65c29 (2026-04-10), not a release zip (GitHub's release downloads were out of reach): folder, file name and entry_symbol init_extension from project/addons/godot-steam-audio/bin/libgodot-steam-audio.gdextension (compatibility_minimum 4.3); newest tag 0.3.1. archived as read from GitHub on 2026-10-22 (docs/addons.md), not read again

addons.name: Godot-PerfBullets
addons.why: its README: "works with Godot 4.1 and 4.2", and "The version included is pre-built for Windows"
addons.fix: Draw bullets with a MultiMeshInstance2D in the game's own code, and remove addons/PerfBullets (docs/addons.md)
addons.head: 80829fb0cf4152d21380e622443cca69b8b59e66
addons.confirmed: 2026-10-23 from the repository at 80829fb (2025-03-05), which has no tags or releases: folder addons/PerfBullets (with plugin.cfg), file spawner.gdextension and entry_symbol spawner_library_init (compatibility_minimum 4.1) from addons/PerfBullets/bin/spawner.gdextension. archived not read (the GitHub API was out of reach)

addons.name: py4godot
addons.why: its README: "Consider this more as a demo and don't use this for bigger projects"; its releases are alphas (4.7-alpha21), for Windows and Linux 64-bit only
addons.fix: Write the game's code in GDScript or C#, and keep py4godot to experiments (docs/addons.md)
